source_caption:
Director Alfonso Cuarón originally hesitated to direct Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban, having not read the books or seen the previous films. His friend, filmmaker Guillermo del Toro, famously encouraged him to accept the job, urging him to read the books and stop being an "arrogant a*****e". This conversation turned out to be pivotal for the franchise, as Cuarón's directing style is credited with redefining the cinematic world of Harry Potter.

The Harry Potter universe is returning with a major new television series adaptation, officially confirmed for release on Christmas Day 2026 on HBO and Max. The series is described as a faithful, decade-long adaptation of J.K. Rowling’s original seven books.
